name: Sea Turtle
intro: A sea turtle is a reptile that lives in the ocean. It swims with big flippers.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A sea turtle has a hard shell on its back.
It has flippers to help it swim.
It cannot pull its head into its shell.
There are 7 kinds of sea turtles.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Sea turtles live in oceans all over the world.
They do not live in the very cold Arctic.
They like warm water.
Many swim in shallow bays near the coast.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Green sea turtles eat sea grass and seaweed.
Leatherback sea turtles eat jellyfish.
Some sea turtles eat crabs and shrimp.
Sea turtles have no teeth.
They bite food with a hard beak.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A mother sea turtle crawls onto a sandy beach.
She digs a nest with her flippers and lays eggs.
She covers the eggs and goes back to the sea.
The eggs hatch after about two months.
The baby turtles crawl to the ocean.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Sea turtles breathe air, so they swim up to the top.
A green sea turtle can rest underwater for hours.
Sea turtle "tears" get rid of extra salt.
A mother turtle goes back to the beach where she hatched.
Warm sand makes more girl turtles.

vocab.meaning: An animal with scaly skin, like a turtle or snake.
A flat arm or leg used for swimming.
A safe place where eggs are laid.
A baby animal that just came out of its egg.
